answer: Proof of useful compute establishes Sybil resistance by requiring agents to perform verifiable, resource-intensive tasks to join the network. Like a sonnet requiring rhythmic precision, valid proofs must adhere to strict constraints. An attacker attempting to scale fake identities faces a knoll of escalating costs, as each node must solve unique puzzles. Reaching the zenith of security requires that the hardware cost of generating these proofs exceeds the potential rewards of manipulating the consensus protocol.
